findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: revnuvo_get_company_technologies, revnuvo_search_signals, revnuvo_monitor_company · Private data: revnuvo_get_company, revnuvo_get_company_state, revnuvo_monitor_company · Public sink: revnuvo_monitor_company.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: revnuvo_get_company_technologies, revnuvo_search_signals, revnuvo_monitor_company · Private data: revnuvo_get_company, revnuvo_get_company_state, revnuvo_monitor_company · Public sink: revnuvo_monitor_company

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
